tspan.tspan: Registering a material receipt (PU03) or a receipt against a
material purchase order adds material stock at the receivin
g site.
A stock check on an order line reserves free product stock;
approving a manufacture work order reserves its material.
Material may be reserved beyond what is on hand — that is
the shortage signal.
When every step is completed, good pieces go into stock
with the lot number and semi-finished ones as semi-finishe
d. Material reservations are released and the used material
is issued (never more than the ledger holds).
A shortage never blocks shipping. The missing quantity is
issued anyway as "shipped without stock" and the stock
goes negative.
Shipping a dispatch delivery order issues the products and
releases their reservation. A stock-storage delivery order p
uts stock in instead.
Recording a return on a shipped delivery order puts the pie
ces back into stock, up to the quantity shipped.
Cancelling a work order, order line or order acceptance rele
ases the reservations it held.
Sending to a subcontractor increases stock held by a partn
er; the return decreases it. It is never counted as own stoc
k.
Completing the regrind product receipt books the customer'
s tools as customer-owned stock. Own stock does not cha
nge.
Every time stock moves, one stock movement slip is kept
with its cause and source document. Nobody can create on
e by hand.
Look by place in Stock overview; items, WIP and reservatio
ns in Inventory (ST01); what moved in Stock movement (ST
Puts one item's past movements and planned ones on a si
ngle timeline to show when it runs short.
Material that will run short is covered by a purchase reques
t and a material purchase order.
Move to another shelf, storage location or site. Only unrese
rved stock can move. The issue at the source and the recei
pt at the target sit on one slip.
Defines the direction (in / out / transfer) and whether source
and target are required. Types are never deleted, only disa
bled.
Pick a movement type and enter item and quantity. Each re
gistration creates one slip with the cause "Manual".
Blocked when the source does not hold enough. Fix the qu
antity or the source.
A transfer records the issue first, then the receipt. To undo
a mistake, post the opposite direction.
Choose a site (and optionally a storage location); every bu
cket there becomes a line, including empty ones. Status: D
raft.
Enter the counted quantities and save. The first save move
s it to Counting; you can save as often as you like.
Possible while Draft or Counting. If approval is pending, the
request is withdrawn too.
Possible once at least one line is counted.
Sent back with a reason, the counts become editable again
Counts are locked while approval is pending. Once every st
ep approves, it is confirmed.
Compares the counts with stock at the moment of confirmat
ion and posts an "Adjustment" slip for the differences only
; no difference, no slip. Status: Confirmed — cannot be undo
ne.
